description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'InvalidURLException' within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin's Exception namespace. The class provides static methods to generate specific exception instances for invalid YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion URLs.

classes.name: InvalidURLException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling invalid URL errors related to video platforms.

methods.name: invalidYouTubeURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException indicating an invalid YouTube URL.

methods.name: invalidVimeoURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException indicating an invalid Vimeo URL.

methods.name: invalidDailymotionURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException indicating an invalid Dailymotion URL.
